text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, still carrying on along the Bakushin Road, vows to score a triumphant win over Nishino Flower. She burns with competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race draws to a head, she declares she'll win over Nishino Flower by 1,000 lengths. With the vow made, she steps foot on the battlefield!
